30 {{i|Fiber}} |tech_tier = 5}} '''Ranch''' is a structure and mechanic in {{PW}}. This building allows multiple Pals in at once to graze and relax. Alongside allowing the [[Pal]]s to relax, they also drop items on the floor of the ranch to be collected. It's a tier 5 [[technology]] item and requires 2 points to unlock. ==Overview== The Ranch building works automatically once any compatible Pals are deployed at Base. Once a Pal walks into the ranch and starts performing labor, they will have the status "Grazing..." until they leave the Ranch. Each Ranch may house up to 4 Pals. ==Strategies== Sanity does not deplete when at the ranch, so you don't need any sanity-based [[passive skills]]. Work speed passive skills do not affect how soon nor how fast they "produce" their drops. The only thing it affects is how fast their "drop found" animation goes, which save minuscule to no time at all. === Best Passive Skills for Ranch Pals === {| class="fandom-table" !'''Reducing Hunger Depletion''' !'''Preventing Sleeping (Unless Dark Type)''' !'''(Optional) Increasing Movement Speed*''' |- |[[Passive Skills#Tier +4 (Diamond)|Mastery of Fasting]] |[[Passive Skills#Tier +4 (Diamond)|Vampiric]] |[[Passive Skills#Tier +4 (Diamond)|Swift]] |- |[[Passive Skills#Tier +3|Diet Lover]] |[[Passive Skills#Tier +1|Nocturnal]] |[[Passive Skills#Tier +4 (Diamond)|Legend]] |- |[[Passive Skills#Tier +1|Dainty Eater]] | |[[Passive Skills#Tier +2|Runner]] |- | | |[[Passive Skills#Tier +1|Nimble]] |} *You do not need movement speed if you put a feed box close to the ranch.
